test_eval_statements: test the pybind11 eval statements module to execute Python statements and capture output
test_eval_single_statement: test the pybind11 eval module to evaluate a single Python expression
test_eval_file: test the pybind11 eval module to evaluate Python code from a file
test_eval_empty_globals: test the pybind11 eval module to verify builtins are injected into empty globals
test_eval_failure: test the pybind11 eval module to handle evaluation failures gracefully
